newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Superfos announces share split.
newsitem.headline: Danish Superfos announces share split.

text.p: Danish construction, chemicals and packaging group Superfos A/S said on Thursday that it would recommend to shareholders a conversion of its present 100 crown shares into 20 crown shares.

"The board recommends that each 100 crown share be split into five new 20 crown shares, which will in future be the nominal value of Superfos' stock," the firm said in a statement accompanying its 1996 result.
Superfos holds its annual general meeting on April 22. --Uffe Hansen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969658
